function.description: Prepare a user approval for canceling one exact active Lighter order. Use when the user wants to cancel a specific order returned by authenticated Lighter open orders. Reads provider state for the selected Core or RHC account, matches the exact string order_id and market, and persists immutable side, price, remaining amount, fills, status, credential scope, and expiry. Returns a trusted approval card; it never loads a private key, reserves a nonce, signs, submits, or treats absence as cancellation.
function.name: lighter__order_cancel_prepare

accountIndex.description: Optional saved Lighter account index. Omit when exactly one managed account exists in the selected environment.

environment.description: Optional Lighter environment for the persisted preview: core for Lighter Core, rhc for Robinhood Chain. Defaults to rhc. Any other value is rejected.

marketId.description: Exact Lighter market index of the active provider order.

orderId.description: Exact decimal provider order_id string from authenticated Lighter open orders. It is never converted to a JavaScript number.
